relationships.subject: oxidative stress
relationships.evidence_quote: Mitochondrial dysfunction, damaged electron transport chains, altered membrane permeability and Ca2+ homeostasis, and impaired mitochondrial defense systems induced by oxidative stress are pathological changes implicated in neurodegenerative disorders
